drone.top: Hi, I'm Byte, Ruben's drone. I'll fly the whole page with you. Scroll down!
drone.ch01: Episode 1: a Minecraft server. This is where the curiosity started, one block at a time.
drone.ch02: A Discord server for anime fans, two bots and a website. Attempt number two.
drone.ch03: No shortcuts here: a course, a lot of commits and plenty of retries.
drone.work: Quest log unlocked. Every card opens a full case study.
drone.skills: Skill tree: each skill links to the project that proves it.
drone.offscreen: Side quests: games, anime and films. Flip the red card for Rule #1.
drone.ch04: Lamp on, code on the screen, me floating next to him. A brand new day.
drone.credits: End of the season. Want to start over? Tap the skull and Return by Death takes you back to zero. Nothing you learned is lost.
